predeclared.adequate_no_survivor: Every adequacy requirement passes but the development-survivor rule does not. This exact bounded implementation is not advanced; no broader cognitive-compilation falsification follows.
predeclared.development_survivor: The treatment is useful on at least four of ten tasks, solves at least three more tasks than each learned control and the prospective no-model compiler control, loses head-to-head on no more than one task against either learned control, has zero unsafe or rollback failures, meets every mechanics and custody floor, and is not dominated on joined model-call, token, verifier, latency, or rollback cost.
predeclared.inconclusive_experiment: Task diversity, matched resources, blind evaluation, source disjointness, uncertainty, weak-tail, or total-cost custody is incomplete.
predeclared.inconclusive_implementation: Any treatment mechanics, parsing/lowering, intervention/locality, checkpoint-independent replay, or corruption floor fails.
predeclared.negative_scope: A null or loss applies only to this exact bounded Python labeled Semantic IR, frozen model, ten-task distribution, completion policy, validator, and repair policy. It cannot falsify cognitive compilation generally.
predeclared.uncertainty: Report all paired win/loss/tie tables, exact one-sided sign probabilities for non-tied treatment-versus-control outcomes, and task-level bootstrap intervals as descriptive development uncertainty; ten tasks cannot support a general population claim.

maximum_inference: This report can decide only whether this exact mechanics-qualified labeled Semantic-IR implementation with the frozen local model survives this ten-task decision-development surface and may be qualified once on fresh source-disjoint D1. It cannot establish or falsify cognitive compilation generally, qualify serving or training, decide D2, or promote ASI Stack book support.
scope: Exact frozen Qwen3.5 model, completion-based P4S labeled Semantic-IR instrument, and ten licensed decision-development tasks. No D1, D2, serving, training, hosted-model, or automatic book-support authority.

termination_custody.completion_rule: Parser-complete artifact or model EOS; the exact prompt residual of the declared model context is the sole numeric boundary. A boundary hit invalidates the observation and is never a mechanism failure.
